See also: Vento, vénto, and ventó

Catalan

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

vento

  1. first-person singular present indicative of ventar

Esperanto

[edit]
Esperanto Wikipedia has an article on:
vento
Wikipedia eo

Etymology

[edit]

From French vent and Italian vento, both from Latin ventus.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈvento/
  • Audio 1:(file)
  • Audio 2:(file)
  • Audio 3:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ento
  • Syllabification: ven‧to

Noun

[edit]

vento (accusative singular venton, plural ventoj, accusative plural ventojn)

  1. (weather) wind
    La vento forte blovis tra la arbaro hieraŭ.
    The wind blew strongly through the forest yesterday.

Derived terms

[edit]
  • suna vento
  • sunvento
  • ventanima
  • ventego
  • ventmuelejo
  • ventoturbino
  • ventumi

Italian

[edit]
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
vento
Wikipedia it

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin ventus (“wind”), from Proto-Italic *wentos, ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *h₂wéh₁n̥ts, from *h₂weh₁- (“to blow”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈvɛn.to/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ɛnto
  • Hyphenation: vèn‧to

Noun

[edit]

vento m (plural venti)

  1. wind (movement of air caused by differences in atmospheric pressure)

Related terms

[edit]
  • mulino a vento
  • rosa dei venti
  • sventare
  • ventaglio
  • ventata
  • venticello
  • ventilare
  • vento solare
  • vento stellare
  • ventola
  • ventosa
  • ventoso

See also

[edit]
  • meteorologia

Latin

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Frequentative of veniō (“to come”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Classical Latin) IPA(key): [ˈwɛn.toː]
  • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [ˈvɛn.to]

Verb

[edit]

ventō (present infinitive ventāre); first conjugation, no passive, no perfect or supine stems

  1. (intransitive) to be wont to come, come often, keep coming, resort
    • Synonym: ventitō

[edit]

See ventus

  • (modern Italianate Ecclesiastical) IPA(key): [ˈvɛn.to]

ventō m

  1. dative/ablative singular of ventus (“wind”)

Portuguese

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈvẽ.tu/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈvẽ.tu/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈvẽ.to/
 
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈvẽ.tu/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈvẽ.tu/
    • (Northern Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈbẽ.tu/

  • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ẽtu
  • Hyphenation: ven‧to

Etymology 1

[edit]

From Old Galician-Portuguese vento, from Latin ventus, from Proto-Italic *wentos, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂wéh₁n̥ts (“blowing”), present participle of *h₂weh₁- (“to blow”).

Noun

[edit]

vento m (plural ventos)

  1. wind (moving air)
  2. (less common) air (gases of the atmosphere)
    Synonym: ar
  3. (Brazil, figurative) nothingness; nothing (the lack of something)
    Synonym: nada
    Coloquei a mão no bolso para pegar a carteira, mas só encontrei vento.
    I put my hand in my pocket to get my wallet, but I found nothing.
Derived terms
[edit]
  • cata-vento
  • para-vento
  • ventinho
Related terms
[edit]
  • vendaval
  • ventã
  • ventar
  • ventilar
Descendants
[edit]
  • Guinea-Bissau Creole: bentu
  • Kabuverdianu: bentu
  • Papiamentu: bientu

Etymology 2

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Verb

[edit]

vento

  1. first-person singular present indicative of ventar

Further reading

[edit]
  • “vento”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “vento”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Ligurian vento. Doublet of viento. Originally a Lunfardo word.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbento/ [ˈbẽn̪.t̪o]
  • Rhymes: -ento
  • Syllabification: ven‧to

Noun

[edit]

vento m (plural ventos)

  1. (obsolete in Rioplatense and Peru, criminal slang in Bolivia and Chile) money
    Synonyms: see Thesaurus:dinero

Venetan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin ventus, from Proto-Italic *wentos, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂wéh₁n̥ts (“blowing”), present participle of *h₂weh₁- (“to blow”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈvɛn.to/

Noun

[edit]

vento m (plural venti)

  1. wind
